title: Fix ContentItem's doc comment claiming it maps to a content_items DB table that no longer exists

evidence.quote:
/// (individual mishna, daf, pasuk, etc.). Maps directly to the
/// `content_items` table schema.
/// replacing the old contentItemId FK to the content_items table.
/// Loads hierarchy content from bundled JSON assets on first access

why: There is no `content_items` table anywhere in lib/core/database/tables/ today; the only other repo references to it (bookmarks.dart, learning_order.dart) describe it in the past tense as an FK that was removed. The actual runtime source, per ContentRepositoryImpl's own doc comment, is bundled JSON assets (assets/content/hierarchy/*.json), not a database table. A maintainer trusting this comment could waste time hunting for a Drift migration that doesn't exist.
recommendation: Update the doc comment to describe the current asset-backed source and drop the content_items-table claim (or mark it explicitly historical).
acceptance_criteria: Comment text matches ContentRepositoryImpl's actual loading mechanism; no remaining present-tense 'content_items table' claim outside historical-context comments
